note: Independent re-judgment after BGP export-chain next-hop unification (cabc8c511e / c2d7117d05). Verified RFC 8669 Sections 3 and 6 ('For future extensibility, unknown TLVs MUST be ignored and propagated unmodified.'), forward_prefix_sid.go (applyEgressPrefixSIDNextHop, prefixSIDNextHopHandler), session_prefix_sid.go (clearLabelIndexTLVs), and all four tagged units. Migrating rfc8669RelayUpdate and TestRFC8669UnknownTLVPropagatedAcrossANextHopChange from NextHopMode to ExportPolicyWithNextHop (BuiltinNextHopUnchanged / BuiltinNextHopSelf) preserves exact next-hop-unchanged and next-hop-self forwarding on both general and route-server rails; prefixsid-malformed-receive.ci migrated its config syntax to bus endpoints without changing any of its 8 sent or 8 expected wire frames. Q1: TestRFC8669UnknownTLVIsIgnored accepts unallocated TLV type 99 unchanged on receive validation; TestClearTransmittedLabelIndexOnlyOnLabeledUnicast and prefixsid-malformed-receive.ci (seq=8) verify unrecognized Label-Index TLV on IPv4 VPN leaves octet-equal with non-zero Reserved/Flags intact; TestRFC8669UnknownTLVPropagatedAcrossANextHopChange verifies unknown TLV type 200 survives byte-identical and in order across both unchanged next hop and next-hop-self on general and RS rails while only SRv6 Service TLVs 5 and 6 are removed. Q2: rejecting unknown TLVs, dropping attribute 40 on next-hop-self, clearing non-LU Label-Index octets, or reordering TLVs fails exact byte equality. Q3: explicit SR-domain settings, valid mandatory attributes, and verified NEXT_HOP before/after isolate unknown-TLV handling. Q4: covers both receive ignore and unmodified propagation (unchanged NH, next-hop-self, unit and live daemon relay).
